summary: Plan fencing for two-host pools, which have no majority: method precedence of BMC, then a sanlock storage lease on shared storage, then an automatically selected Corosync quorum-device witness (another pool's master, else the Controller), each with its own exclusion proof rules, gating automatic takeover. Amends two platform-plan rules accordingly. Follow-on to the automatic host fencing plan. Planning only. API impact: changed contract (planned, not implemented).

guide.reason: No behaviour changes; the pool authority guide is updated in the implementing slices.

api.reason: Planning only. The plan declares changed host-report, pool-record, witness-registration and proof contracts for the implementing slices; docs/API.md lists no unimplemented interface as implemented.

roadmap.reason: No milestone changed status; the published board still describes shipped behaviour. The decision is recorded in docs/plans.

state.reason: No state changes in this record. The planned feature is Core-owned: the pool master's durable record holds the lease repository, watchdog owner and witness registration, recovered through master inventory. A Controller acting as witness stores no pool state and is re-selected automatically by the pool, so the Controller-scoped list is unchanged.

verification.method: Documentation link and scope review; documentation and privacy gates run.
